selection_rationale.priority: No V2 experiment was open or reserved, no candidate-source or novelty input changed after the prior outcome-blind scout rejection, and no admission-ready scout existed. The prior receipt named the repository-external append-anchor decision packet as the next clean M2 unit.
selection_rationale.candidate_readiness_reuse: The SEC contract-relation source manifest, source rows, frozen-family metadata, and experiment-registry hashes still matched the rejected zero-ID preflight, so its failed predicates were reused without opening outcome files or consuming an experiment ID.
selection_rationale.chosen_unit: Freeze a target-independent, machine-verifiable append-anchor acceptance and deployment contract while leaving actual target selection and connector implementation blocked on explicit user authorization.
selection_rationale.scope_boundary: Decision packet, tests, navigation, durable decision, and a stale V2 parity sentence only. No external account, namespace, credential, connector, runtime writer/reader, source record, universe state, candidate, signal, outcome, policy, scheduler, broker, order, allocation, evidence tier, canonical eligibility, or trading permission changed.

outcome_access_containment.detail: Only committed V2 state, backlog, receipts, decision metadata, source-input hashes, code contracts, tests, and experiment status metadata were used.

implementation.immutable_decision_packet: data/v2/repository_external_append_anchor_decision_packet.json is an immutable target-independent packet with contract SHA-256 76c8c20e28fddbf167d12202332907ead7a95dd5f7c4352507aeacb6a4dce2ed. It must not be filled or overwritten in place.
implementation.rollback_threat: The contract addresses repository-local replacement with an older internally valid HEAD. Git, local self-hashes, mutable rows, ordinary versioning, or co-located signing keys are explicitly rejected as freshness anchors.
implementation.transition_and_successor_contract: One approved anchor-genesis cutover is followed by every append, zero-event manifest, and rotation HEAD transition. Monotonic sequence alone is insufficient: append/zero-event must extend the exact anchored checkpoint/tail/tip, rotation must bind compacted_from_head, and rollback-then-append forks fail closed.
implementation.target_and_retention_contract: The future target must sit in an independent administrative boundary and provide locked immutable retention, ordered append or predecessor CAS, strong latest/read-after-write, conditional idempotent create, and provider receipts bound to the approved contract, target, immutable locator, object bytes, policy version, and retain-until time.
implementation.principal_and_secret_boundary: The pre-cutover selected contract must freeze distinct non-secret writer, reader, and retention-admin IAM principal IDs plus named owners. Repository records may contain only secret-store references, never credential bytes.
implementation.two_stage_activation: After explicit authorization, a new immutable selected-target contract is frozen before sequence 1. A separate post-cutover activation receipt binds the selected contract, provider receipt, independent read-principal raw evidence, exact anchor-object hash, and causal service/readback/cutover/anchor-gate clocks.
implementation.eligibility_boundary: The activation receipt must keep canonical_forward_eligibility_started_at null until a separate canonical review. The anchor is prospective only, cannot upgrade existing evidence, and is not a bounded-scout precondition.
implementation.acceptance_surface: A1-A14 cover create-only collisions, IAM separation, strong independently evidenced readback, lost acknowledgements, valid-old-HEAD rollback, gaps/forks, outage, rotation, cross-stream replay, remote ahead/behind, rollback-then-append, anchor genesis, and wrong target/retention receipts.
implementation.parity_document_repair: The V2 parity matrix now accurately records segmented_hot_v1 as an explicit research-only backend beside explicit legacy_jsonl_v1, with no auto-detection, cold traversal, fallback, Engine-0, production, canonical, paper/live, execution, or trading claim.

closed_findings: Added transition-specific successor validation so an old valid HEAD cannot be rolled back, extended into a new branch, and re-anchored by sequence continuity alone.
Separated anchor-genesis cutover from ledger bootstrap and made all eligibility prospective.
Bound provider receipts to the selected target contract and locked retention evidence with exact byte recipes.
Made the decision packet immutable and separated the pre-cutover selected contract from the post-cutover activation receipt to avoid self-reference and future-fact backfill.
Required independent read-principal raw evidence and exact anchor-object identity instead of a self-reported readback timestamp.
Added machine-comparable writer, reader, and retention-admin IAM principal IDs in addition to owners.
Removed an impossible zero-event rule that simultaneously required event_count to increase and remain unchanged.
Changed the flow endpoint from canonical-consumable to anchor-gate-satisfied-only and kept canonical_forward_eligibility_started_at null.
